findings.description: Critical: The plan correctly identifies that parked escalations should be routed immediately through the escalate-resume gate after durable parking, ensuring routing occurs only after lease release and result validation.

Critical: The proposed separation between apply operation and retryable route_parked_escalations maintains the important architectural principle that routing failure cannot replay dispatch_fn effects, preserving idempotency and preventing duplicate work.

Critical: The approach correctly handles retry safety by ensuring that routing errors fail closed after durable parking, allowing only the routing method to be retried without replaying already-applied batches or dispatch_fn effects.
Optional: Consider specifying the exact return structure of the new route_parked_escalations method in the design document to ensure consistent implementation and clear contract boundaries.

Optional: The specification should clarify how the bounded resolution entries returned by route_parked_escalations will be used by the calling host to determine if escalations resumed or remain pending, particularly regarding the format and content of these entries.

Critical: The design properly excludes ordinary pending_gate, failed, and quarantined attempts from the escalation routing path, maintaining backward compatibility and existing behavior for non-policy-pause parked states.

Critical: The reuse of gate_router.resolve_parked ensures that all existing gate evaluation logic, prior-record rules, audit recording, and mirror projection continues to function correctly without duplication or divergence.

Optional: Consider adding explicit test scenarios for the interaction between the new routing functionality and the existing supervisor mirror/handoff projection to ensure blocked decisions with deadlines are properly maintained across retries.

Optional: The design should specify how the injectable gate evaluator parameter in route_parked_escalations will be utilized in testing vs. production environments to ensure proper testability and deterministic behavior.

Critical: The plan correctly identifies that routing must occur after apply_delegated_batch to ensure correlated results and exact loop-state evidence have been checked, preventing premature gate evaluations.
